answer: A concrete sybil defense is proof-of-funding with slow, time-locked deposits instead of free identity creation. Each new agent locks real capital in escrow for a full epoch before it may attest or vote, and that lock is public, so a swarm of fresh identities costs N times the stake rather than nothing. A gale of fakes cannot rotate fast enough since release trails registration by many blocks. Reviewers sample attestations like pigment on a canvas, so copied work stands out, and coherence is weighed like a sonnet where one stolen line breaks the rhyme.
